WebSearch for 'The Lawn Butcher Lakeland FL google maps' and 'The Lawn Butcher Lakeland FL email contact' surfaced no business-owned website, only one third-party directory (z1biz.com) and unrelated Lakeland lawn-care competitors. The business's only public link is its Facebook page (facebook.com/TheLawnButcher), confirmed directly on one of its own Google Business Profile photos (the promotional flyer graphic lists 'Facebook.com/TheLawnButcher' as the contact channel, no website URL). Conclusion: has_own_site = false.

Attempted WebFetch of facebook.com/TheLawnButcher/about to look for a website link or extra contact info in the About section; Facebook returned only the page title with the body truncated/inaccessible to the fetcher (expected for a logged-out fetch of a Facebook page), so the About tab itself could not be read, but no separate website domain appears anywhere else public (own flyer, directory listing, or search results). No Instagram presence found for this business in any source.

reviews_verbatim.name: Austin Stone
reviews_verbatim.text: Kyle and his crew did an amazing job upgrading our landscaping. I gave him my vision for the backyard and he delivered 1000% and delivered on my unrealistic timeline for an outdoor party we were having to boot! Everyone loved the work they did! Great communication and even better work ethic. If you need to upgrade your yard or landscaping, give him a call. Update: the guys came back to do mulch, sod, and aluminum landscape border. They did a jam up job and made the front yard pop.

reviews_verbatim.name: Devin Schaefer
reviews_verbatim.text: The Lawn Butcher is the real deal for all your landscaping needs! Kyle just got done completely transforming our backyard. He tore out all the vegetation, put in new mulch, and laid Provista sod. We could not be more happy with how it turned out. Kyle provided excellent customer service from start to finish always showing up on time and working with us to give us exactly what we wanted. Giving him a 5 star review was a no brainer. Stop looking and hire him now!

reviews_verbatim.name: Jessica Raysin
reviews_verbatim.text: Our backyard is very shaded and very wet during the rainy season. The sod we installed when we built the house didn't last 1 year. We consulted with Kyle about the type of sod to install that would last. We went with his recommendation of St Augustine Seville and he installed it last October 2022. It is still flourishing and looks as perfect as the day it was installed in July of 2023! Would recommend The Lawn Butcher to anyone looking for new sod. You're in great hands with Kyle!

reviews_verbatim.name: Brittany Stone
reviews_verbatim.text: Kyle did an amazing job landscaping our backyard! He paid so much attention to detail and really made our dream come together. Highly recommend him!

reviews_verbatim.name: Carlos S JR
reviews_verbatim.text: Kyle was great and very personable. He did an amazing job with our lawn. Great communication and exceptional service! He was very informative and he gave us clear advice on how to maintain our lawn. I would definitely recommend him for anyone needing lawn care services.

reviews_note: All 5 verbatim quotes were provided pre-verified in the task brief (sourced from the business's real Google reviews, 4.9 rating / 31 reviews). The 3 richest in concrete detail (Austin Stone, Devin Schaefer, Jessica Raysin) were used in the site's testimonials section, matching the skeleton's 3-review grid; Brittany Stone and Carlos S JR are recorded here for completeness but not displayed on the site.

photo_curation_note: All 11 provided Google Maps photo URLs were downloaded and every one was visually inspected with the Read tool before any was used (gmaps-1 through gmaps-11). 2 (gmaps-1, gmaps-2) are the same promotional flyer containing a family photo and were excluded from the site entirely (no selfies/family portraits used as gallery tiles, matching the pipeline's visual curation rule). The remaining 9 were all usable real work/property photos; 6 went into the main gallery grid (all finished results or an in-progress sod install, no blurry/cluttered shots, no captions/text overlays), 2 (a fence/lawn shot and a crew-shadow/equipment shot) were used only as About-section ambiance rather than gallery tiles since they are process shots rather than finished 'wow' results, and 1 (the stand-on mower) was used as the small circular owner-operator avatar instead of a headshot, since no usable face photo of Kyle alone exists among the verified photos. All images were resized to a max width of 1200px and re-compressed to JPEG quality 82 before use, per the pipeline's performance rule.
brand_vibe: Built on templates/dark-v2, repainted via the colorsys hue-rotation method in scripts/derive.py to an olive/lime green family (hue 95, sat_mult 0.9, light_mult 1.0; resulting --accent-deep #85cd52), matching the business's own cartoon mascot logo's bright grass-green overalls while staying clearly distinct (hue ~95, olive/lime) from the emerald/teal green palette family (hue ~145) used by another landscaping business in the same Lakeland batch, per this task's explicit instruction. The gold Merktop badge was protected and left untouched by the hue shift.
